methodologyNotes: Covers standalone residential chest and upright freezers sold at a published US MSRP or typical retail price. Excludes thermoelectric/passive coolers, combination refrigerator-freezers, and commercial reach-in units. Price is typical US retail or MSRP in USD. configuration is 'chest' (top-opening lid) or 'upright' (front door). capacityCubicFt is the manufacturer-rated total/gross storage volume in cubic feet. defrostType is 'manual' or 'frost-free' (automatic defrost). energyUseKwhYr is the EnergyGuide/DOE-rated annual electricity consumption in kilowatt-hours per year (lower is better); null if not disclosed. energyStarBool is true if the model is ENERGY STAR certified. widthInches, heightInches, and depthInches are exterior dimensions in inches with the lid/door closed and excluding handles. storageBasketCount is the number of included wire storage baskets (chest) or shelves (upright). garageReadyBool is true when the manufacturer rates operation across a wide ambient range (approximately 0 to 110 F). warrantyYears is the manufacturer's parts warranty length in years (sealed-system/compressor coverage may run longer). Numeric specs are pulled from manufacturer spec sheets; null where a value is not published.
